open_points.subject: Facts several modules touch, and their one owner — Data and Configuration
open_points.text: **Data.** Every policy value generated code reads — a threshold, a name, a path, a closed set or a table over a State 1 enumeration — is a typed constant of `data_provider`, imported by name; no other module holds or repeats it (SPEC_STANDARD 6.10, 15.4; 2026-11-08).
open_points.question: Are deployment-dependent thresholds and paths such as `binary_max_read_bytes` and `binary_storage_root` exceptions to this statement, or must generated code obtain them as typed `data_provider` constants instead of fields of `RuntimeSettings`?
options: Limit the Data statement to release policy values and obtain both binary settings from `RuntimeSettings` on every read
Treat every threshold and path literally as `data_provider` data and remove the binary values from `RuntimeSettings`
State an explicit classification rule separating deployment values from release policy values
open_points.default_guess: Treat the specific Configuration, `binary_storage`, `runtime_settings`, and A30 passages as authoritative: deployment-dependent values come from `RuntimeSettings`, and revise the Data statement to cover only release policy values.

witness.initial: A deployment starts successfully with `BINARY_MAX_READ_BYTES` set to 1048576, while a release-level binary-read constant chosen under the Data passage would allow 10485760 bytes; a stored authorized object is 2097152 bytes.
events: The host operator starts the service with the deployment environment and `runtime_settings` validates it.
An authorized client requests the stored document or photo.
`binary_storage` applies the source of the read bound selected by the implementer.
outcomes: Following the Configuration passages, `binary_storage` reads `binary_max_read_bytes = 1048576` from the freshly loaded `RuntimeSettings` and rejects the read with `BinaryStorageError`.
Following the Data passage literally, `binary_storage` applies the release constant of 10485760 and returns the exact 2097152 bytes.
witness.observer: The authorized client sees either a storage-unavailable failure or a successful binary response; the deployment operator also sees whether the configured bound is effective.
